Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting liability for persons working with liquefied petroleum gas.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting liability for persons who work withliquefied petroleum gas; and adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who sells at retail, supplies, handles, or transportsliquefied petroleum gas is not liable for civil damages for death,injury, or loss of property caused by: (1) The installation, alteration, modification, or repair ofliquefied petroleum gas equipment or a liquefied petroleum gasappliance if the installation, alteration, modification, or repair wasdone without the constructive knowledge and consent of the personselling, supplying, handling, or transporting liquefied petroleum gas;or (2) The use of liquefied petroleum gas equipment or a liquefiedpetroleum gas appliance in a manner or for a purpose other than thatfor which the equipment or appliance was intended or foreseeable and p. 1 SSB 5657that could not reasonably have been expected.
